title: Display
description: Display text's segments (spec.md §2.7, ADR 0054): sent as '<member>-segments' beside a display string, to a host that declared the 'segments' capability.

Segments.title: Segments
Segments.description: A display member's segments, sent as '<member>-segments' beside it ('text-segments', 'message-segments') when the host declared the 'segments' capability: the pieces of the display string, in order. Their texts, joined, are exactly the string; a host that finds otherwise prints the string. Flat: a piece is never inside another.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: One piece of a display string, and what it is.

kind.description: What the piece is, never how it looks: each host maps a kind to its own look. Absent is plain text. Open vocabulary: a host prints a kind it does not know as plain text.
